lines.text: Dance, dance, little snowflake, tumbling gently from the sky!
Is it really true that no two snowflakes on Earth are ever identical?
Yes! High in the frosty clouds, water freezes around a tiny speck of dust!
Water molecules always link up into a six-sided hexagonal crystal shape!
As the snowflake drifts down, wind, temperature, and humidity change every second!
Each branch grows differently based on the exact path it travels through the air!
With trillions of possibilities, every single flake is a one-of-a-kind frozen artwork!
Now you know the winter magic behind every falling snowflake!
